AllocationStrategy.description_en:
The capacity allocation policy, which determines how the scaling group selects available instance types to meet the capacity requirements. The capacity distribution policy applies to both pay-as-you-go and spot capacities. This parameter takes effect only when the MultiAZPolicy parameter is set to COMPOSABLE. Valid values:

priority: Creates instances based on the order of the configured instance types.
lowestPrice: Creates instances based on the unit vCPU price of the instance types in ascending order
AllocationStrategy.description_zh:
容量分配策略，决定了伸缩组如何选择可用的实例规格类型满足容量。容量分布策略同时对按量和抢占式容量生效（仅当`MultiAZPolicy`参数取值为`COMPOSABLE`策略时生效）。可能值：

priority：按照配置的实例规格的顺序创建实例。
lowestPrice：按照实例规格单位vCpu价格从低到高创建实例

AutoRebalance.description_en:
Indicates whether automatic balancing is enabled for the scaling group. This parameter takes effect only when BalancedOnly is enabled for zone balancing. Valid values:
false: Automatic balancing is disabled for the scaling group.
true: Automatic balancing is enabled for the scaling group. The scaling group automatically detects the capacity across zones. If the capacity is unbalanced, the scaling group proactively scales out or scales in to rebalance the capacity across zones
AutoRebalance.description_zh:
是否开启伸缩组自动均衡，仅当可用区均衡伸缩组开启了BalancedOnly才生效。可能值：
false：不开启伸缩组自动均衡。
true：开启伸缩组自动均衡时，伸缩组会自动检测可用区见容量，当可用区容量不均衡时，会主动进行可用区扩缩，进行可用区容量再均衡

AzBalance.description_en:
Indicates whether the capacity of the scaling group is evenly distributed across multiple zones. This parameter takes effect only when the MultiAZPolicy parameter is set to COMPOSABLE. Valid values:

true: The capacity of the scaling group is evenly distributed across multiple zones.
false: The capacity of the scaling group is not evenly distributed across multiple zones
AzBalance.description_zh:
伸缩组的容量是否在多个可用区间均衡分布（仅当`MultiAZPolicy`参数取值为`COMPOSABLE`策略时生效），可能值：

true：伸缩组的容量在多个可用区间均衡分布。
false：伸缩组的容量不在多个可用区间均衡分布

BalanceMode.description_en:
The zone balancing mode. This parameter takes effect only when the zone balancing mode is enabled. Valid values:
 
BalancedBestEffort:
If resource creation fails in a zone, the system falls back to other zones to ensure best-effort delivery of resources.

BalancedOnly:
If resource creation fails in a zone, the system does not fall back to other zones. The scale-out activity partially succeeds to avoid excessive imbalance of resources across different zones
BalanceMode.description_zh:
可用区均衡模式，仅当开启可用区均衡模式时生效。可能值：
 
BalancedBestEffort：
当某可用区资源创建失败时，会降级至其他可用区，保障资源的尽力交付。

BalancedOnly：
当某可用区资源创建失败时，不会降级至其他可用区，扩容活动部分成功，避免资源在不同可用区过度不均衡

CompensateWithOnDemand.description_en:
Specifies whether to automatically create pay-as-you-go instances to meet the required number of ECS instances when the MultiAZPolicy parameter is set to COST_OPTIMIZED and sufficient spot instances cannot be created due to price or inventory reasons. Valid values:

true: Allowed.
false: Not allowed
CompensateWithOnDemand.description_zh:
当`MultiAZPolicy`取值为`COST_OPTIMIZED`时，如果因价格、库存等原因无法创建足够的抢占式实例，是否允许自动尝试创建按量实例满足ECS实例数量要求。可能值：

true：允许。
false：不允许

OnDemandBaseCapacity.description_en: The minimum number of pay-as-you-go instances required in the scaling group. If the number of pay-as-you-go instances in the scaling group is less than this value, the system preferentially creates pay-as-you-go instances. Valid values: 0 to 1000
OnDemandBaseCapacity.description_zh: 已有伸缩组内所需要的按量实例数的最小值，当伸缩组内按量实例个数少于该值时，系统将优先创建按量实例。可能值：0~1000

OnDemandPercentageAboveBaseCapacity.description_en: The percentage of pay-as-you-go instances among the excess instances after the scaling group meets the minimum number of pay-as-you-go instances specified by OnDemandBaseCapacity. Valid values: 0 to 100
OnDemandPercentageAboveBaseCapacity.description_zh: 伸缩组满足最小按量实例数`OnDemandBaseCapacity`要求后，超出的实例中按量实例应占的比例。可能值：0～100

PriceComparisonMode.description_en:
The price comparison mode of the cost optimization policy for the scaling group. Valid values:
PricePerUnit: Compares prices based on the price per unit of capacity.

  The capacity of an instance in the scaling group is equal to the weight set for the instance type. The default weight is 1, which means one ECS instance occupies one unit of capacity.

PricePerVCpu: Compares prices based on the price per vCPU
PriceComparisonMode.description_zh:
伸缩组成本优化策略的比价模式。可能值：
PricePerUnit：使用每单位容量价格比价。

  实例在伸缩组中容量大小等于为实例规格设置的权重，默认为1，即一台ECS所占容量为1。

PricePerVCpu：使用每单位vCpu价格进行比价

SpotAutoReplaceOnDemand.description_en:
Specifies whether to use spot instances to replace pay-as-you-go capacity when CompensateWithOnDemand is enabled and the percentage of pay-as-you-go instances exceeds the value of OnDemandPercentageAboveBaseCapacity. In common scenarios where CompensateWithOnDemand downgrades spot instances to pay-as-you-go instances due to spot inventory or price reasons, this parameter attempts to use spot instances to replace the excess pay-as-you-go capacity to avoid long-term retention of pay-as-you-go instances. Valid values:

true: Allowed.
false: Not allowed
SpotAutoReplaceOnDemand.description_zh:
当开启`CompensateWithOnDemand`后，如果按量比例超过`OnDemandPercentageAboveBaseCapacity`比例时，会尝试使用spot替换按量容量。常见场景`CompensateWithOnDemand`因Spot库存或价格原因导致Spot降级按量实例，为避免按量实例长时间存在，尝试使用Spot替换多余的按量容量。取值范围：

true：允许。
false：不允许

CompensateWithOnDemand.description_en:
Specifies whether to automatically create pay-as-you-go instances to meet the requirement for the number of ECS instances when the MultiAZPolicy parameter is set to COST_OPTIMIZED and the required number of spot instances cannot be created due to price or inventory issues. Valid values:

true: Yes.
false: No
CompensateWithOnDemand.description_zh:
当MultiAZPolicy取值为COST_OPTIMIZED时，如果因价格、库存等原因无法创建足够的抢占式实例，是否允许自动尝试创建按量实例满足ECS实例数量要求。可能值：

true：允许。
false：不允许

DefaultCooldown.description_en: The default cooldown time of the scaling group. During the cooldown time, the scaling group does not execute any other scaling activity. GroupType.description_zh: 伸缩组管理的实例类型

HealthCheckType.description_en:
The health check mode of the scaling group. Valid values:

NONE: No health check is performed.
ECS: Health checks are performed on instances in the scaling group. This value is used to enable health checks for instances in both ECS and ECI scaling groups.
LOAD_BALANCER: The health status of instances is determined based on the health check results of load balancing (the CLB load balancing type is not supported)
HealthCheckType.description_zh:
伸缩组的健康检查方式。可能值：

NONE：不做健康检查。
ECS：对伸缩组内的实例做健康检查（ECS类型和ECI类型的伸缩组均使用本取值开启实例健康检查）。
LOAD_BALANCER: 根据负载均衡（暂不支持clb负载均衡类型）健康检查结果判断实例健康状态

HealthCheckTypes.description_en:

LOAD_BALANCER: The health status of instances is determined based on the load balancing health check results. The CLB load balancing type is not currently supported
HealthCheckTypes.description_zh:

LOAD_BALANCER: The health status of instances is determined based on the load balancing health check results. The CLB load balancing type is not currently supported
items.description_zh:

InitCapacity.description_zh: 伸缩组中处于实例扩容前初始化状态的实例数量

LaunchTemplateId.description_en: The ID of the launch template used by the scaling group
LaunchTemplateId.description_zh: 伸缩组使用的实例启动模板的ID

LaunchTemplateOverrides.description_en: The extended instance type information of the launch template
LaunchTemplateOverrides.description_zh: 扩展启动模板的实例规格信息

items.description_en: The extended instance type information of the launch template
items.description_zh: 扩展启动模板的实例规格信息

InstanceType.description_en: The specified instance type, which overrides the instance type in the launch template
InstanceType.description_zh: 指定的实例规格，会覆盖启动模板中的实例规格

SpotPriceLimit.description_en:
The maximum spot price for the instance type that overrides the launch template (namely, LaunchTemplateOverride.InstanceType).

本参数用于指定实例启动模板覆盖规格（即`LaunchTemplateOverride.InstanceType`）的竞价价格上限。
仅当`LaunchTemplateId`参数指定了启动模板时，该参数才生效

WeightedCapacity.description_en: The weight of the specified instance type, which indicates the capacity of a single instance of this instance type in the scaling group. A greater weight indicates that fewer instances of this instance type are required to meet the expected capacity
WeightedCapacity.description_zh: 指定实例规格的权重，即实例规格的单台实例在伸缩组中表示的容量大小。权重越大，满足期望容量所需的本实例规格的实例数量越少

LaunchTemplateVersion.description_en: The version of the launch template used by the scaling group

LifecycleState.description_en:
The lifecycle state of the scaling group. Valid values:

Active: The scaling group is active. Only active scaling groups can accept requests to execute scaling rules and trigger a scaling activity.

Inactive: The scaling group is inactive. Inactive scaling groups do not accept any requests to execute scaling rules.

Deleting: The scaling group is being deleted. Scaling groups in the Deleting state do not accept any requests to execute scaling rules, and their parameters cannot be modified
LifecycleState.description_zh:
伸缩组的状态信息。可能值：

Active：生效状态，处于生效状态的伸缩组才能接收执行伸缩规则的请求并触发伸缩活动。

Inactive：失效状态，处于失效状态的伸缩组不接收任何执行伸缩规则的请求。

Deleting：伸缩组正在删除，处于删除中状态的伸缩组不接收任何执行伸缩规则的请求，并且不能修改伸缩组相关参数

items.description_en: The list of load balancing configurations

A higher weight specifies that more access requests are distributed to the ECS instance. If the weight is 0, the ECS instance does not receive access requests. Valid values: 0 to 100

The maximum lifetime of an instance in the scaling group. Unit: seconds.

Valid values: 0 or [86400, Integer.maxValue]. A value of 0 indicates that the configured value of MaxInstanceLifetime is cleared, which means MaxInstanceLifetime is not configured.

Default value: null.

This parameter is not supported for ECI scaling groups or scaling groups that have the economical mode enabled
MaxInstanceLifetime.description_zh:
实例在伸缩组中存活的最大时间。单位为秒。

默认值：null。

ECI类型的伸缩组或停机不收费的伸缩组不支持设置该参数

ModificationTime.description_en: The time when the scaling group was modified. The time follows the ISO 8601 standard in the YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mmZ format. The time is displayed in UTC
ModificationTime.description_zh: 伸缩组的修改时间，采用ISO 8601标准的UTC时间，格式为YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mmZ

MonitorGroupId.description_en: The ID of the CloudMonitor application group associated with the scaling group
MonitorGroupId.description_zh: 伸缩组关联的云监控应用分组ID

MultiAZPolicy.description_en:
The scale-out and scale-in policy for ECS instances in a multi-zone scaling group. Valid values:
         
PRIORITY: The scaling group scales instances based on the vSwitches specified by VSwitchIds. If ECS instances cannot be created in the zone of the vSwitch with the highest priority, the system automatically uses the vSwitch with the next highest priority to create ECS instances.

COST_OPTIMIZED: The system attempts to create instances based on the unit price of vCPUs in ascending order. If the scaling configuration settings specify multiple instance types that use the spot billing method, the system preferentially creates spot instances. You can use the CompensateWithOnDemand parameter to specify whether to automatically create pay-as-you-go instances when spot instances cannot be created due to insufficient inventory.
COST_OPTIMIZED takes effect only when the scaling configuration settings specify multiple instance types or use spot instances.

BALANCE: The system evenly allocates ECS instances across the zones specified for the scaling group. If the distribution becomes unbalanced due to insufficient inventory, you can call the RebalanceInstance operation to balance the resources
MultiAZPolicy.description_zh:
多可用区伸缩组ECS实例扩缩容策略。可能值：
         
PRIORITY：根据您定义的虚拟交换机（VSwitchIds）扩缩容。当优先级较高的虚拟交换机所在可用区无法创建ECS实例时，自动使用下一优先级的虚拟交换机创建ECS实例。

COST_OPTIMIZED：按vCPU单价从低到高进行尝试创建。当伸缩配置设置了抢占式计费方式的多实例规格时，优先创建对应抢占式实例。您可以继续通过CompensateWithOnDemand参数指定当抢占式实例由于库存等原因无法创建时，是否自动尝试以按量付费的方式创建。
COST_OPTIMIZED仅在伸缩配置设置了多实例规格或者选用了抢占式实例的情况下生效。

BALANCE：在伸缩组指定的多可用区之间均匀分配ECS实例。如果由于库存不足等原因可用区之间变得不平衡，您可以通过API RebalanceInstance平衡资源

OnDemandBaseCapacity.description_en: The minimum number of pay-as-you-go instances required in the scaling group. Valid values: 0 to 1000. When the number of pay-as-you-go instances in the scaling group is less than this value, the system preferentially creates pay-as-you-go instances
OnDemandBaseCapacity.description_zh: 已有伸缩组内所需要的按量实例数的最小值，取值范围：0~1000。即当伸缩组内按量实例个数少于该最小值时，系统将优先创建按量实例

OnDemandPercentageAboveBaseCapacity.description_en: The percentage of pay-as-you-go instances to be created when the number of instances exceeds the minimum number of pay-as-you-go instances specified by OnDemandBaseCapacity. Valid values: 0 to 100
OnDemandPercentageAboveBaseCapacity.description_zh: 伸缩组满足最小按量实例数（ondemandbasecapacity）要求后，超出的实例中按量实例应占的比例，取值范围：0～100

PendingCapacity.description_en: The number of ECS instances that are being added to the scaling group and are pending configuration
PendingCapacity.description_zh: 正在加入伸缩组，还未完成相关配置的ECS实例的数量

PendingWaitCapacity.description_en: The number of ECS instances in the Pending Wait state in the scaling group
PendingWaitCapacity.description_zh: 伸缩组中处于加入挂起状态的ECS实例的数量

ProtectedCapacity.description_en: The number of ECS instances in the Protected state in the scaling group
ProtectedCapacity.description_zh: 伸缩组中处于保护中状态的ECS实例的数量

RegionId.description_en: The ID of the region to which the scaling group belongs

RemovalPolicies.description_en:
The collection of policies for removing ECS instances from the scaling group. Valid values:
OldestInstance: Removes the ECS instance that was created at the earliest point in time.
NewestInstance: Removes the ECS instance that was created at the latest point in time.
OldestScalingConfiguration: Removes the ECS instance that was created by the earliest scaling configuration
RemovalPolicies.description_zh:
ECS实例移出伸缩组的策略的集合。可能值：
OldestInstance：移出最早创建的ECS实例。
NewestInstance：移出最新创建的ECS实例。
OldestScalingConfiguration：移出最早由伸缩配置创建的ECS实例

items.description_en:
The collection of policies for removing ECS instances from the scaling group. Valid values:
OldestInstance: Removes the ECS instance that was created at the earliest point in time.
NewestInstance: Removes the ECS instance that was created at the latest point in time.
OldestScalingConfiguration: Removes the ECS instance that was created by the earliest scaling configuration
items.description_zh:
ECS实例移出伸缩组的策略的集合。可能值：
OldestInstance：移出最早创建的ECS实例。
NewestInstance：移出最新创建的ECS实例。
OldestScalingConfiguration：移出最早由伸缩配置创建的ECS实例

RemovingCapacity.description_en: The number of ECS instances that are being removed from the scaling group
RemovingCapacity.description_zh: 正在移出伸缩组的ECS实例的数量

RemovingWaitCapacity.description_en: The number of ECS instances in the Removing Wait state in the scaling group
RemovingWaitCapacity.description_zh: 伸缩组中处于移除挂起状态的ECS实例的数量

ResourceGroupId.description_en: The ID of the resource group to which the scaling group belongs

ScalingGroupId.description_en: The ID of the scaling group

ScalingGroupName.description_en: The name of the scaling group

ScalingPolicy.description_en:
The reclaim mode of the scaling group. Valid values:
         
recycle: The scaling group uses the shutdown reclaim mode.
release: The scaling group uses the release mode.
forcerelease: The scaling group uses the force release mode.

For more information about the actions on removed instances, see [RemoveInstances]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25955.html）
ScalingPolicy.description_zh:
指定伸缩组的回收模式。可能值：
         
recycle：伸缩组的回收模式为停机回收模式。
release：伸缩组的回收模式为释放模式。
forcerelease：伸缩组的回收模式为强制释放模式。

关于被移出实例的动作，请参见[RemoveInstances]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25955.html）

ServerGroups.description_en:
The collection of information about load balancing service groups.

You can use this parameter to obtain the collection of information about ALB service groups, Network Load Balancer (NLB) server groups, and Gateway Load Balancer (GWLB) service groups associated with the scaling group
ServerGroups.description_zh:
负载均衡服务器组的相关信息集合。

您可以通过此参数获取伸缩组关联的ALB类型服务组、NLB类型服务器组和GWLB类型服务组的相关信息集合

items.description_en: The collection of information about the load balancing server group
items.description_zh: 负载均衡服务器组的相关信息集合

Port.description_en: The port number used by the ECS instance after Auto Scaling adds the ECS instance to the server group
Port.description_zh: 弹性伸缩将ECS实例添加到服务器组后，ECS实例使用的端口号

ServerGroupId.description_en: The ID of the server group

Type.description_en:
The type of the server group. Valid values:

ALB: Application Load Balancer (ALB) for application-layer load balancing.
NLB: Network Load Balancer (NLB) for network-layer load balancing.
GWLB: Gateway Load Balancer (GWLB) for gateway load balancing
Type.description_zh:
服务器组类型。可能值：

ALB：表示应用型负载均衡（Application Load Balancer）。
NLB：表示网络型负载均衡（Network Load Balancer）。
GWLB：网关型负载均衡 GWLB（Gateway Load Balancer）

Weight.description_en: The weight of the ECS instance as a backend server after Auto Scaling adds the ECS instance to the server group
Weight.description_zh: 弹性伸缩将ECS实例添加到服务器组后，ECS实例作为后端服务器的权重

SpotAllocationStrategy.description_en:
The spot capacity distribution policy. You can use this parameter to separately specify the distribution policy for spot capacity. This parameter takes effect only when the MultiAZPolicy parameter is set to COMPOSABLE. Valid values:

priority: Creates instances based on the order of the configured instance types.
lowestPrice: Creates instances based on the unit vCPU price of the instance types in ascending order.

Default value: priority
SpotAllocationStrategy.description_zh:
抢占式容量分布策略。您可以通过该参数单独指定抢占式容量的分布策略（仅当`MultiAZPolicy`参数取值为`COMPOSABLE`策略时生效）。可能值：

priority：按照配置的实例规格的顺序创建实例。
lowestPrice：按照实例规格单位vCpu价格从低到高创建实例。

默认值：priority

SpotCapacity.description_en: The number of spot instances in the scaling group
SpotCapacity.description_zh: 伸缩组中抢占式实例的数量

SpotInstancePools.description_en: The number of available instance types that are specified. The scaling group creates spot instances in a balanced manner based on the most cost-effective instance types. Valid values: 0 to 10
SpotInstancePools.description_zh: 指定可用实例规格的个数，伸缩组将按成本最低的多个规格均衡创建抢占式实例。取值范围：0~10

SpotInstanceRemedy.description_en: Indicates whether the spot instance replenishment feature is enabled. If this feature is enabled, when the scaling group receives a system message indicating that a spot instance will be reclaimed, the scaling group attempts to create a new instance to replace the spot instance to be reclaimed
SpotInstanceRemedy.description_zh: 是否开启补齐抢占式实例。开启后，当收到抢占式实例将被回收的系统消息时，伸缩组将尝试创建新的实例，替换掉将被回收的抢占式实例

StandbyCapacity.description_en: The number of instances in the Standby state in the scaling group
StandbyCapacity.description_zh: 伸缩组中处于备用状态的实例数量

StopInstanceTimeout.description_en: The timeout period for waiting for an ECS instance to be stopped during the scale-in process. Unit: seconds
StopInstanceTimeout.description_zh: 缩容流程中等待ECS实例停机成功的超时时间，单位为秒

StoppedCapacity.description_en: The number of instances in the scaling group that are in the economical mode
StoppedCapacity.description_zh: 伸缩组中处于节省停机效果的实例数量

SuspendedProcesses.description_en:
The suspended processes. If no process is suspended, an empty value is returned. Valid values:

ScaleIn: The scale-in process.
ScaleOut: The scale-out process.
HealthCheck: The health check process.
AlarmNotification: The event-triggered task process.
ScheduledAction: The scheduled task process
SuspendedProcesses.description_zh:
暂停中的流程，如果没有，则返回值为空。可能值：

ScaleIn：缩容流程。
ScaleOut：扩容流程。
HealthCheck：健康检查。
AlarmNotification：报警任务。
ScheduledAction：定时任务

items.description_en:
The suspended processes. If no process is suspended, an empty value is returned. Valid values:

ScaleIn: The scale-in process.
ScaleOut: The scale-out process.
HealthCheck: The health check process.
AlarmNotification: The event-triggered task process.
ScheduledAction: The scheduled task process
items.description_zh:
暂停中的流程，如果没有，则返回值为空。可能值：

ScaleIn：缩容流程。
ScaleOut：扩容流程。
HealthCheck：健康检查。
AlarmNotification：报警任务。
ScheduledAction：定时任务

SystemSuspended.description_en:
Indicates whether Auto Scaling stops executing any scaling activity in the scaling group. Valid values:

true: Auto Scaling stops executing any scaling activity in the scaling group. This indicates that the scaling group has failed to scale out or scale in for more than seven consecutive days. You must modify the scaling group or scaling configuration to resume the execution of the scaling activity.

false: Auto Scaling executes the scaling activity in the scaling group
SystemSuspended.description_zh:
弹性伸缩是否停止执行伸缩组内的伸缩活动。可能值：

true：停止执行伸缩组内的伸缩活动，说明该伸缩组已经连续扩缩容失败超过7天。您需要修改伸缩组或者伸缩配置，来恢复伸缩活动的执行。

false：执行伸缩组内的伸缩活动

Tags.description_en: The tags of the scaling groups
Tags.description_zh: 伸缩组的标签信息集合

items.description_en: The tags of the scaling groups
items.description_zh: 伸缩组的标签信息集合

Propagate.description_en:
Indicates whether the tag is a propagated tag. Valid values:
true: Tags on the scaling group are propagated only to newly created instances, but not to instances that are already running in the scaling group.
false: Tags on the scaling group are not propagated to instances.

Default value: false
Propagate.description_zh:
标识该标签是否为可传播标签，可能值：
true：伸缩组上的标签只会传播到新创建的实例上，而不会传播到已经在伸缩组中运行的实例上。
false：伸缩组上的标签不会传播到实例上。

默认值：false

TagKey.description_en: The tag key of the scaling group

TagValue.description_en: The tag value of the scaling group

TotalCapacity.description_en: The total weighted capacity of all ECS instances in the scaling group if instance type weights are configured. Otherwise, this parameter indicates the total number of ECS instances in the scaling group
TotalCapacity.description_zh: 当伸缩组设置了实例规格权重，表示伸缩组内所有ECS实例的加权容量总和。否则，表示伸缩组内所有ECS实例的数量

TotalInstanceCount.description_en: The total number of ECS instances in the scaling group
TotalInstanceCount.description_zh: 伸缩组内所有ECS实例的数量

VServerGroups.description_en: The list of backend server groups

items.description_en: The list of backend server groups

LoadBalancerId.description_en: The ID of the load balancing instance to which the backend server group belongs
LoadBalancerId.description_zh: 后端服务器组所属的负载均衡实例的ID

VServerGroupAttributes.description_en: The property of the backend server group

items.description_en: The property of the backend server group

Port.description_en: The port number used by the load balancing instance to provide external services
Port.description_zh: 负载均衡实例对外提供服务的端口号

VServerGroupId.description_en: The property of the backend server group

Weight.description_en: The weight of the backend server group

VSwitchId.description_en: The ID of the vSwitch associated with the scaling group
VSwitchId.description_zh: 伸缩组关联虚拟交换机的ID

VSwitchIds.description_en: The collection of IDs of the vSwitches associated with the scaling group. If you specify the VSwitchIds parameter, the VSwitchId parameter is ignored
VSwitchIds.description_zh: 伸缩组关联虚拟交换机的ID集合。如果您使用了VSwitchIds参数，VSwitchId参数将被忽略

items.description_en: The collection of IDs of the vSwitches associated with the scaling group. If you specify the VSwitchIds parameter, the VSwitchId parameter is ignored
items.description_zh: 伸缩组关联虚拟交换机的ID集合。如果您使用了VSwitchIds参数，VSwitchId参数将被忽略

VpcId.description_en: The ID of the VPC to which the scaling group belongs

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of scaling groups
